## Description
This modpack provides a lightweight, performance-focused setup for players who want a smooth Minecraft experience with essential quality-of-life features. It includes a curated set of mods, resource packs, and shader configurations used in the MineCrew SMP project, but without the heavier additions found in [MinewCrew-Extra](https://modrinth.com/modpack/minecrew-extra).

### What it does
- Improves client performance through optimized mods and settings
- Adds useful building and utility tools such as Litematica and ClientSort
- Provides pre-configured shaders and resource packs for a consistent visual style
- Keeps the overall modlist small to maintain fast loading times and high FPS

### Why you might want it
- You want the MineCrew SMP experience without the heavier mods
- You want a plug-and-play pack that performs well on mid-range systems
- You prefer a clean, minimal setup that still improves gameplay quality

## Important information
- This pack is designed to work in both singleplayer and multiplayer.
- Some servers may not allow client-side mods included in this pack (e.g., Litematica, Freecam). Always check the server’s rules before joining.
- The pack does not include server-side modifications and does not circumvent server protections.
